folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation: five-family intake and selected absorption, 2026-11-04 (B361)
folds.body:
The complete reconciliation JSON is a targeted five-family disposition, not full reading of every metadata path or every linked semantic receipt. Its family snapshotPaths total2,279, while this checkpoint separately names2,374metadata paths; scope/time/overlap definitions were not reconciled here, so neither number proves missing records or full-corpus coverage. Each family explicitly limits its semantic reading. Preserve the selected/unselected/source-missing/independent boundaries instead of upgrading “family complete” into all-game/all-world completion.

GD-01, known routes, acquired home/retort and ACS-P01/P02/P03 supply distinct finite consumers. A route projection does not create travel or grants; balm uses the actual native effect/custody and one publisher; cooling preserves paid preparation, retry/outcome and its existing useful consumer; agreed duty preserves actual consent, funded priority and attributed settlement. The source-ready selections do not establish every source game, power or later progression system. Whole Factorio recovery remains its independent objective.

Historical source matching, shared joins, repaired seams, parse checks and the370-source/37-vendor matching build retain their exact receipt scope. Empty mismatch fields, ready/released roles and queued immutable preview are not fresh runtime, current worker or browser evidence. The JSON’s four source-repaired seams and checkpoint’s five integration repairs are separately reported snapshots, not proof of a new defect. Source/build completion and explicitly unrun native/constructor/save/failure/keyboard tests remain distinct; current AD43 governs future gameplay completion. The old one-prestige framing is superseded and generic human review is optional under AD42. No source/module/hash, process, preview, build or gameplay check was rerun here.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation: player-agency map and source boundaries, 2026-11-04 (B361)
folds.body:
P01–P11 all retain implemented-unverified/deferred-unrun behavior status. The map describes one finite Paradise binding among19unactivated agency contracts, not nineteen playable worlds or full-novel/roster parity. Its52Paradise commands equal38player plus14NPCcommands; registry counts and source paths are definition-level evidence, not native reachability or completed gameplay. The independent entry preserves its chosen actual body/control/cargo profile rather than replacing a protagonist or granting their source automatically.

Preserve ordinary work/own growth, optional cooperation, material civilian interventions, cause-driven independent NPC actions, changed retained local outcomes and actual personal/contract return as distinct mechanisms. Authoring seven people and finite controllers is not a generic arbitrary-NPC attack/death system. Current-source stock, private knowledge, actual supplied means and absence policy stay scoped; a retained visit count is not permission to silently prune histories or credit paused-world production. Numerical time/budgets/dialogue and concurrent hub/earlier-era placement remain original branch choices.

The supplied MTL/source-footprint qualification is not primary-canon approval or a new full reading. Current source/edition owners determine any later lore claim; no unconfirmed stock or mana was made current by this review. Expansion10/book1/native1 and old-reader refusal are compatibility contracts requiring actual semantic admission and roundtrip proof; absent-state inertness differs from auto-enrollment or item seeding. Fieldcraft’s observation/name/charge projection does not alter native identity or imply all candidate mechanics. Existing build/release evidence and later actual adoption remain separate. The old one-prestige limit is superseded; no unit/browser/persistence/failure or current campaign behavior was newly checked here.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation: causal analysis map versus later source release, 2026-11-04 (B361)
folds.body:
The complete revision2 coverage JSON routes20CSErequirements to five proposed packets and four worked cases. A requirement linked to one or several packets is analysis coverage, not proof that the requirement is implemented, source-qualified or exercised. Its nativeImplementationPerformed:false and followup implementationPerformed:false belong to that earlier analysis revision; this revision6checkpoint separately records later seven-module source delivery and release. Preserve both rather than treating an old false flag as a new missing-feature finding or source-ready as completed gameplay.

Retain useful distinctions among actual strike/capture/release, support invalidation, known reports, source counters, established anchors and independently retained closure facets. Present power or a prediction does not by itself create an anchor. Witnesses need actual access and channels; a retained terminal receipt cannot arbitrarily block recovery or mint a replayed refund. These local original proof profiles do not force universal mortality, destiny repair, conservation or protection rules across worlds. Source research, public theory comparison and original scenario invention remain different evidence classes.

The seven-module packet and63-command/five-controller definition checks require the exact shared registry, body/stock/job context, native admission, save/restore and single-publisher consumers named above. Source hashes, syntax/import and combined definition checks alone do not establish those native behaviors. The historical instruction deferring gameplay checks applies to that source role; it does not lower current AD43 completion requirements or forbid relevant checks in a separately authorized implementation. Current actual integrator ownership and evidence determine adoption. No linked model/source case, runtime, build, saved state or gameplay gate was reverified by reading this map and checkpoint.
